summary: A new price that carries no times: after Flattrade's snapshot with its feed time (ft), trade time (ltt) and change (pc), a partial with only a new lp keeps them, as does a partial with only a new volume. A tf is a partial update: a key it leaves out has not changed (the review's R107-10, withdrawn for partial-update feeds).

notes: A tf leaves out what has not changed: docs/port/market-data-frames.md, Partial-update feeds; lead correction 2026-11-09, .lane/107/decisions.md: a field a partial packet omits is unchanged, not unknown. The web's cache gives the same frames.
Client a holds Quote and client b LTP on one touchline subscription.

deviations.reason: Noren's touchline carries the book totals (tbq, tsq), and the web's Flattrade Quote dict drops them: lost data. The desktop keeps them (lead decision: data a web adapter drops from a mode is kept).
